product.title: Product
product.description: Track your brand across Korean and English AI answers.

meta.title: Is AI recommending your brand?
meta.description: ChatGPT, HyperCLOVA, Perplexity, Naver, Claude, Daum, Gemini. Findable tracks where your brand stands in 7 Korean and English AI answers.

meta.title: Findable Blog
meta.description: GEO research, K-brand AI visibility insights, and Korean AI engine deep-dives.

meta.title: Talk to a Findable expert
meta.description: Schedule a 30-minute consultation. We'll walk you through your brand's AI visibility, your competitors' positioning, and the fastest path to improving your Share of Voice.

benefits.title: Live brand audit walk-through
benefits.description: We run your domain through all 7 engines live and explain every finding, in Korean and English.

benefits.title: Competitor benchmark
benefits.description: Bring 3-5 competitors. We show you exactly where you stand and what they're doing right.

benefits.title: GEO action plan
benefits.description: Leave with a concrete 30-day plan based on Princeton's KDD'24 GEO algorithm and our 4-agent recommendations.

emptyState.heading: How often does your brand show up in AI answers?
emptyState.lede: Customers now ask AI instead of typing into a search box. See how the major AI engines talk about your brand — and get help making them talk about it better.
emptyState.reclaimBody: Your audit results follow the email address you entered at the time.
emptyState.reclaimSignedIn: . If you ran the audit with a different address, please sign in with that one.
emptyState.reclaimAnonymous: If you ran the audit with a different address, please sign in with that one.
emptyState.step1Body: Just your website address is enough.
emptyState.step2Body: We check whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and other major AI engines mention you.
emptyState.step3Body: How often they mention you, which sources they cite, and what to fix.
emptyState.cta: Add a brand and start measuring
emptyState.footnote: About 1–3 minutes · Starts on the free plan · The example is a real measurement

onboarding.emptyHint: Nothing yet. You can skip this.
onboarding.introLede: Just your domain. We infer industry and target market from it, and you can change them later.
onboarding.introWhyBody: Some tools ask ten questions at signup, but the more you ask, the more there is to get wrong. We infer industry and target market from your domain and show you why we decided that way. If it is wrong, fix it right there.
onboarding.introEngines: We measure ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini alongside Naver, Daum and HyperCLOVA. No matter which market you pick, none of these are dropped.
onboarding.scopeLede: We inferred this from your domain. If it looks right, just continue.
onboarding.scopeLowConfidence: Confidence is low, so please double-check.
onboarding.scopeEnginesNote: Whichever you pick, the AI engines stay the same — ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Naver, Daum and HyperCLOVA. This choice only shapes which channels we recommend.
onboarding.aliasTitle: We also go by these names
onboarding.aliasLede: AI answers may call {brand} by other names. Add whatever comes to mind.
onboarding.aliasWhyBody: AI refers to the same brand in both Korean and English. Counting the two spellings separately makes your brand look less visible than it is. List them here and we count them as one.
onboarding.competitorTitle: You are compared against these brands
onboarding.competitorLede: We've pre-filled competitors AI identified. Remove any that don't fit.
onboarding.competitorLedeEmpty: Add the brands you want to compare against. You can leave this empty and move on.
onboarding.competitorWhyBody: We use it to merge Korean and English spellings when counting competitors in AI answers. It never hides competitors that are missing from this list — we still show the ones you did not know about.
onboarding.doneStarted: Measurement has already started. It usually takes 1-3 minutes.
onboarding.doneRateLimited: You already measured today. You can see the existing results on your dashboard.
onboarding.doneFailed: Your brand was registered but measurement could not start. You can retry from the dashboard.
onboarding.doneAsideTitle: From now on, we check every day
onboarding.doneAsideBody: We automatically run brand prompts every day across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Naver, Daum, HyperCLOVA X, tracking how your visibility changes.
onboarding.donePreviewLabel: Example screen · not your real results
onboarding.donePreviewCaption: Once measurements build up, you'll see visibility trends like this
onboarding.featurePreviewTitle: More becomes available as measurements build up
onboarding.featureCompareDesc: Compare how often AI mentions you versus competitors
onboarding.featureSourcesDesc: See which pages AI cites when it talks about you
onboarding.featureAlertsDesc: Get notified when your visibility shifts significantly
onboarding.saveFailedHint: You can change these settings later.
onboarding.editorAliasHint: So AI does not count Korean and English spellings separately. e.g. Amorepacific
onboarding.editorCompetitorHint: Competitors missing from this list are never hidden — we only use it to merge spellings.
onboarding.editorSaved: Saved. It applies from the next measurement.
onboarding.editorDirtyHint: Saving applies from the next measurement.

content.title: Turn measurement evidence into citable content
content.description: Findable drafts from your latest SEO/GEO evidence. You edit and approve it, then quality checks run before public publication.
content.emptyTitle: No content has been created yet
content.emptyDescription: Complete a brand measurement to create the first draft from its latest content action and measured evidence.
content.editorDescription: Review the measurement basis and correct anything exaggerated or unverifiable before approval.
content.excerptLabel: Summary shown in listings and search
content.seoTitleLabel: SEO title · defaults to article title
content.moderationWaiting: The editorial team is reviewing the full article and evidence. It remains hidden from search until publication.
content.moderationDescription: Review new publishers and quality warnings before public publication.
content.moderationEmpty: No content is waiting for editorial moderation.
content.moderationConfirm: I reviewed the full article, measurement evidence, and original sources.

exportDialog.title: Export data
exportDialog.description: Download your measurement data as CSV. Choose a period and columns.
exportDialog.columnsBase: Date, brand, engine, mentioned, rank, sentiment, share (default)
exportDialog.includeSources: Include cited sources (URLs the AI cited as evidence)
